name: Aegilock Transaction Guardian for WooCommerce
author: Thomas Röhrig

sections.description:
Professional transaction security for WooCommerce stores

Aegilock Transaction Guardian helps protect your WooCommerce store by analyzing orders for potential security risks. The plugin provides intelligent risk assessment tools and configurable actions to help merchants make informed decisions about order processing.

Core Features:

  • Order Analysis – Systematic evaluation of order characteristics
  • Risk Assessment – Multi-factor analysis of order patterns
  • Configurable Actions – Set custom responses for different risk levels
  • Admin Dashboard – Overview of order analysis statistics
  • Email Notifications – Alerts for orders requiring attention
  • Test Mode – Evaluate system performance without affecting orders
  • HPOS Compatible – Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

Risk Factors Analyzed:

Our system evaluates various order characteristics:
– Address consistency checks
– Geographic location analysis
– Order timing patterns
– Customer account status
– Order value assessment
– Payment method evaluation

Admin Interface

The plugin provides:
– Statistics dashboard
– Risk score monitoring
– Usage tracking
– Order review tools
– Configuration settings

Configuration Options

  • Adjustable risk thresholds
  • Customizable response actions
  • Geographic filtering options
  • Test mode for evaluation
  • Detailed activity logging

External Services

This plugin connects to the Aegilock API for enhanced fraud detection and risk assessment services.

Service Details:
– Service: Aegilock Fraud Detection API (https://api.aegilock.de)
– Purpose: Risk analysis and fraud detection for WooCommerce orders
– When data is sent: Only when an API key is configured and orders are placed (completely optional)
– Data transmitted: Order metadata including amount, country codes, payment method, and order timing (no personal customer information such as names, addresses, or payment details)
– Frequency: Per order when protection is enabled
– Optional: This service is entirely optional – the plugin functions locally without an API key

Legal Information:
– Terms of Service: https://www.aegilock.de/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.aegilock.de/datenschutz.html
– Data Protection: All data transmission uses encrypted HTTPS connections
– Contact: kontakt@aegilock.de

Important: Using the external API service is completely optional. You can request an API key by contacting kontakt@aegilock.de, but the plugin will function with basic features without any external connection.

Legal Notice

Aegilock Fraud Prevention is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WooCommerce or Automattic Inc. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc.

This plugin is provided “as is” without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The plugin creators and distributors shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of this software. Users are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in their jurisdiction.

The fraud detection algorithms are designed to assist merchants in identifying potentially risky transactions but should not be the sole basis for transaction decisions. Merchants should use their own judgment and may wish to implement additional verification procedures.

All trademarks mentioned are the property of their respective owners.

Privacy and Data Protection

Data Processing:
– Only order metadata required for risk assessment is processed
– No unnecessary personal data collection or storage
– Processing occurs in accordance with applicable privacy laws

Data Security:
– Secure transmission of analysis data
– Local storage of configuration and logs only
– No unauthorized data sharing

User Rights:
– Store owners control all plugin data
– Easy removal via plugin deactivation
– Complete data cleanup on uninstall

Contact for Privacy Matters:
Email: kontakt@aegilock.de

Support and Contact

Technical Support: kontakt@aegilock.de
API Key Requests: kontakt@aegilock.de
General Inquiries: kontakt@aegilock.de

Response Time: We aim to respond to emails within 24 hours during business days.

Legal Notice

This plugin is provided “as is” without warranty of any kind. Users are responsible for compliance with applicable laws and regulations in their jurisdiction.

For complete terms of use and privacy policy, contact: kontakt@aegilock.de
sections.installation:
Requirements:
– Active WooCommerce installation
– Valid API key (request via email)

Installation Steps:

  1. Install and activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  2. Request API key by emailing: kontakt@aegilock.de
  3. Include your domain name and intended usage in the email
  4. Wait for API key delivery (typically within 24 hours)
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Aegilock
  6. Enter your API key and configure settings
  7. Enable test mode for initial evaluation
  8. Review settings and activate protection

API Key Request Process:

To obtain your API key, send an email to kontakt@aegilock.de with:
– Subject: “API Key Request – [Your Domain]”
– Your website domain
– Expected monthly order volume
– Contact information

API keys are provided at our discretion based on legitimate business needs.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Send an email to kontakt@aegilock.de with your domain name and business details. API keys are provided for legitimate WooCommerce stores.

How does the risk assessment work?

The system analyzes various order characteristics and provides a risk score. No personal customer data is processed inappropriately.

Will this affect my checkout process?

No. Analysis occurs after order placement and does not impact the customer checkout experience.

What happens to flagged orders?

Based on your configuration, orders can be:
– Marked for manual review
– Automatically processed with notation
– Logged for analysis

Can I test the system first?

Yes! Use test mode to evaluate the system without affecting order processing.

What data is processed?

Only order metadata necessary for risk assessment. No sensitive personal data is stored or transmitted unnecessarily.

Is there a cost?

API access terms are provided when you request your API key. Contact kontakt@aegilock.de for current pricing.

What support is available?

Technical support is available via kontakt@aegilock.de for API key holders.
